Hire a Healthcare Virtual Assistant for $9.50/Hour

We provide dedicated, HIPAA-compliant Medical and Healthcare Virtual Assistants to medical, dental, optometry, and veterinary practices. Our virtual assistants handle EMR documentation, medical scribing, and back-office administrative tasks—so you can streamline operations, increase revenue, and leave the office on time.

Healthcare Professionals

Work with licensed nurses and healthcare professionals in the Philippines trained as dedicated Healthcare and Medical Virtual Assistants supporting medical and specialty practices.

Schedule a Call

Flat-Rate Pricing $9.50/Hour

Flat-rate pricing at $9.50 per hour. No long-term contracts. No setup fees. Flexible staffing designed for growing medical and specialty practices.

Selective Screening & Healthcare Training

We are highly selective about who we bring on. Every assistant goes through a multi-step screening process, skills testing, and hands-on HIPAA training before working with any practice.

HIPAA Compliant Virtual Assistants

All Healthcare Virtual Assistants complete HIPAA training and follow strict privacy and security protocols to protect your patients, data, and practice.

Dedicated Virtual Assistant — Not a Rotating Team

Our clients are able to work with the same virtual assistant everyday to ensure consistency and allow for a long-term working relationship.

Virtual Assistant Services for Modern Medical Practices

From real-time medical documentation to front-desk coordination and back-office support, our HIPAA compliant virtual assistants integrate seamlessly into your practice so your team can focus on patient care, not paperwork.

Real-time medical documentation, charting, and EMR support from trained healthcare virtual assistants who work directly within your existing workflows.

For Doctors.
Built by a Doctor.

Hello Rache was founded in 2017 by Dr. Mark Carnett, D.O. - a practicing family physician who experienced first-hand the burnout caused by EMR documentation and administrative overload.

After years of staying late to finish charts and manage back-office tasks, Dr. Carnett set out to build a better solution — one designed specifically for medical practices.

That’s when Hello Rache was born. Dr. Carnett has been using HelloRache Healthcare Virtual Assistants in his practice in Arizona for years now.

It has saved him lots of stress, money, and most importantly, time
